## Summary

<!-- What does this PR change and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] feat: new functionality
- [ ] fix: bug fix
- [ ] docs: documentation only
- [ ] refactor: no behavior change
- [ ] chore: tooling, deps, CI
- [ ] test: tests only

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test` passes locally
- [ ] New and changed files carry `// doc:` headers, and the linked docs are updated
- [ ] Prose reads like a person wrote it: plain, no stock AI patterns
- [ ] No secrets or workspace user data included
- [ ] Commit message follows Conventional Commits
